These fixtures retain the installed ZCode CLI key structure inspected on
2026-10-31. `profile.json` includes only the selected model/options and empty
personal model-rule lists. `builtin.json` includes only the bundled matching
GLM-5.3 model rule's `modelMatch` and `optionSpecs.reasoningLevel.values`.
Credentials, provider access configuration and option transformation maps are
omitted. Tests supply explicit overrides and invalid lists separately.
